inputs.note: Replace sentinel with actual accepted hash before binding.

actions: Blockout metric dimensions/sockets/clearance; if AI mesh, inspect hidden surfaces, fusion, holes and baked lighting. Compare silhouette from gameplay camera and two gear swaps.
expected_observations: Body scope and modular seams feasible before texture/rig batch.

actions: Create deformation edge flow around required joints; preserve source high/low meshes and triangulation policy; evaluate silhouette and LOD transitions.
expected_observations: Extreme deformation regions supported, triangle/material budget bound to actual target.

actions: Lay out UV with checker/overlap policy/texel density/padding. Bake with explicit cage. Preserve texture masters; map base/emissive color separately from normal/ORM data channels.
expected_observations: No unacceptable seam/distortion; roughness/metallic/normal/color conventions verified.

actions: Build rest/control/deform skeletons, sockets and weights. Bake unsupported controls; stress squat/reach/grip/twist/landing and gear seams. Auto-rig only within witnessed body scope.
expected_observations: Weights/influence limits/rest bind/DOF correct, deformation visually accepted.

actions: Author or lawfully retarget clips using rest/bone/scale map. Bake Actions with exact bounds/fps/loop/root policy. Store event times in sidecar; controller or allowed root delta owns displacement.
expected_observations: Start/stop/turn/blend/contact/release/cancel; no double root/controller motion or accumulated drift.

actions: Export pinned GLB preset, run glTF validator, clean-import scene, bind colliders/actions/sockets/markers and material tiers; measure on due native target.
expected_observations: Format validity plus semantics, stress poses, gameplay contact, native profile; source reopens without missing add-ons.
